eigen-proof-of-concept.title: Eigen: Building a Workspace
eigen-proof-of-concept.summary: After two months of development, I built a working proof of concept for a Google Workspace alternative where you control your own data. Here's what works and what's next.

eigen-six-months-later.title: Eigen: Six Months Later
eigen-six-months-later.summary: Six months after the proof of concept, Eigen grew from five basic apps to a full workspace with calendar, spreadsheets, slides, chat, IMAP and CalDAV. Now I need testers, and people who can help figure out what's next.
